courses.title: Free Elective
courses.choice_note: [7] Free Electives: 15 semester credit hours are required for the B.S. in Marketing.

courses.title: Guided Elective
courses.choice_note: [8] Marketing Guided Electives: Students may choose 12 hours from one Track or any combination of courses within the following Tracks: Professional Sales Track Retailing Innovation Track Digital Marketing Track Marketing Analytics Track Marketing Management Track Any guided elective courses listed above can satisfy guided elective requirements in prior BS MRKT catalogs if not used elsewhere on the student's degree plan. Three semester credit hours of upper-division MKT courses, not listed or applied as credit hours elsewhere on the student's degree plan, may be used to fulfill a guided elective with advanced written permission from the BS MRKT Program Director. [9] An Internship (Practicum) of at least 160 working hours is required for all JSOM majors. MKT 4V90 for up to 3 semester credit hours can apply towards free or guided electives. MKT 4090 or BA 4090 for 0 semester credit hours will fulfill degree requirement only. Students who are employed in full-time jobs may fulfill their internship requirement with their current employer as a special project for registration in BA 4090 with preapproval from the Marketing Program Director.
